admission.justification: Realized in mcp/src/agents_remember/package_data/paseo_plugin/index.client.tsx, where OpenTarget forwards agentId alone to navigation.openAgent, and in mcp/src/agents_remember/package_data/paseo_plugin/client/bridge.ts, where openAgent turns the request into navigation without a workspace hop of its own.

applicability: Every navigation from an ar.open carrying an agentId, on document and Chats pages.
conditions: The application's session holds the agent, so pinned resolveNavigateToAgent can resolve it.
exclusions: Workspace-only opens, which set the workspace and clear the selection.
Unknown or archived agents, which stall or fail rather than navigate.
statement: Navigation carries the agent alone and the application resolves its workspace from its own session (pinned resolveNavigateToAgent); the R1 workspace-hop and mismatch-refusal are withdrawn as unsupported by the native contract, and the R1 fake-workspace-scoped failure is withdrawn as the developer's cause.
